title: Batched urgency inflation: one mention upgrades whole payload
description: §7 says 'When any entry in messages has hasMention or hasMentionAll set to true ... the server MUST use mentionUrgency for the entire payload delivery.' A batch of 20 routine messages is delivered at high urgency because one message mentions the user. This may be intentional, but the spec should explicitly acknowledge the trade-off and state whether it is the desired behavior.
close_reason: Added rationale sentence: entire batch promotes to mentionUrgency to avoid silent demotion of mention
